summary: Lindsay Corporation, a Delaware-incorporated NYSE-listed farm equipment maker, filed an 8-K disclosing a cooperation agreement dated November 4, 2026 with the Vision One fund entities, settling a previously noticed activist campaign. Lindsay will nominate Marvin E. Washington as an independent director at the fiscal 2027 annual meeting for a term expiring at the fiscal 2030 meeting, recommend and solicit proxies for him, and appoint him to the Audit Committee. Board size is capped at nine; Vision One gains replacement rights while meeting a minimum ownership threshold. Vision One irrevocably withdrew its October 5, 2026 nomination and proposal notice and ceased solicitation. Management also agreed to submit binding proposals to declassify the board. Watch for the ownership threshold and standstill terms in the full agreement, and whether declassification passes.
